component.summary: Configure the gaming keys of Logitech G keyboards
Configurar las teclas G de los teclados Logitech G
Configurer les touches G des claviers Logitech G
Configura i tasti G delle tastiere Logitech G
Configurar as teclas G dos teclados Logitech G

description.p: With gkey-config you assign keys, key combinations, mouse buttons and macros to the gaming keys of Logitech G keyboards and keypads driven by the Linux kernel driver hid-lg-g15. A small user daemon applies the bindings; no extra kernel or USB driver is needed.

ul.li: Three layers (M1–M3) per profile, with the layer LEDs
Macros with recording, repeat while held, toggle or a fixed count
G13 stick as keys, mouse pointer, scroll wheel or joystick
G13 LCD pages: status, clock and text from scripts

description.p: Supported: Logitech G13 (Linux 6.19 or newer); Logitech G15 and G510, untested.

screenshot.caption: Stick as keys, dead zone and rest position

description.p: The RAM row of the LCD system page shows its value again.
New LCD page with the load of CPU, RAM, GPU and VRAM and the temperatures of CPU and GPU.
First release: G13 keys, layers, macros, backlight, stick and LCD; six languages.
